mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market growth (PAYEMS) is strong but consumer spending (RSAFS) is declining, it indicates an economic imbalance that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and RSAFS declines by more than 0.3% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (defined by strong GDP growth and low unemployment), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals impending monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (late-cycle expansion with CPIAUCSL rising), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in the late-cycle regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average indicates weakening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 600,000 units per month signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) signals a supportive monetary environment that compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Robust job growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 new jobs per month signals strong consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.04.
